LEAVE AND LICENCE AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made at Mumbai on 1 July 2025 between Mr. S. Kulkarni,
residing at Dadar, Mumbai (hereinafter "the Licensor") and Ms. T. Menon,
residing at Andheri, Mumbai (hereinafter "the Licensee").

1. PREMISES AND TERM
The Licensor grants the Licensee a licence to occupy Flat 7B, Seaview Towers,
Bandra, Mumbai for a period of eleven months with effect from 15 July 2025.

2. RENT
The Licensee shall pay a monthly licence fee of Rs. 45,000 on or before the tenth
day of each calendar month by bank transfer to the account notified in writing.

3. SECURITY DEPOSIT
The Licensee shall pay an interest-free security deposit equivalent to two months
licence fee, that is Rs. 90,000. The deposit shall be refunded within thirty days
of the Licensee vacating the premises, less only deductions for damage beyond
normal wear and tear, each supported by a written itemised account.

4. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS
The Licensor shall bear the cost of structural repairs and of society maintenance
charges. The Licensee shall bear the cost of minor repairs arising from day to day
use and shall keep the premises in clean and habitable condition.

5. TERMINATION
Either party may bring this Agreement to an end by giving the other two months
written notice. On such notice the Licensee shall vacate the premises and the
Licensor shall refund the deposit in accordance with clause 3.

6. EXTENSION
This Agreement may be extended for a further period on such terms as the parties
may agree in writing before the expiry of the term.

7. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any dispute shall be referred to a sole arbitrator appointed by mutual agreement of
the parties. The seat of arbitration shall be Mumbai.

8. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at Mumbai
shall have jurisdiction.
